manual_validation.source_level_validation: RustAssure reports return distance 1000 with identical argument graphs. The C side contains 36,595 return expressions from the original GF(2) matrix computation, while frozen Rust has only direct crc1/crc2 return graphs. This collapse follows directly from using the zero-initialized output matrix as the gf2_matrix_times input and then swapping the even/odd applications, which is the catalogued S21 root cause.
manual_validation.c_oracle_status: The reviewed crc1=9, positive-len2 witness uses only initialized entries of the C 32-element matrix and produces the established return mismatch; thus a C-defined behavior represented by the differing computation exists.
manual_validation.paper_summary: RustAssure detected S21: its return-graph collapse was manually traced to the two erroneous GF(2) matrix substitutions on a C-defined input.
